## Change and user-visible behaviour

## Validation

- [ ] Stable IDs preserved; schema/content versions correct; legacy endpoint compatible.
- [ ] Content schemas, references and compatibility validation pass.
- [ ] Meaningful visual alt text and media-unavailable text/audio pathway reviewed (no invented alt for nonvisual content).
- [ ] Timing, accessible alternatives, attribution, source and licence reviewed.
- [ ] Bundles use supported capabilities, preview exactly what is added, and default to disabled.
- [ ] Relevant Flutter/native tests run; device execution distinguished from compilation.
- [ ] Maintainer approval obtained before merging content to main. CODEOWNERS alone does not enforce approval.
